name: Eiffel Tower
description: Eiffel Tower: Known as the landmark of Paris, the Eiffel Tower is an iron hollow tower located on the Champ de Mars. It is the tallest building in Paris and a cultural symbol of France. The tower was originally built to welcome the World's Fair and the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution in a few years. It was named after the designer Eiffel. The Eiffel Tower still stands tall on the banks of the Seine River after hundreds of years of ups and downs. Male and female couples also use it as an emotional token to symbolize their loyal love for each other.
